lines: This afternoon, an abhorrent scheme to disrupt the unveiling of the People's Monument today was thwarted by the hands of Svetka herself.
Five heartless dissidents attacked our leader, brandishing handguns as she was addressing the public at the unveiling ceremony.
However, before they could act, Svetka disarmed their leader, and members of her security retinue sprang into action and apprehended the others.
Through the quick and decisive thinking of our leader, the People's Monument, commissioned to remember the sacrifices of our martyrs five years ago, went on as planned.
